hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Custom curve hook for a phiEth/ETH pool that enforces 1:1 swaps. It intercepts swaps via beforeSwap, calls phiEth.deposit or phiEth.withdraw directly, settles the output, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to no-op the AMM's concentrated liquidity math. The pool must be fee-zero, and liquidity addition is permanently blocked.
